title: Settings: fix missing accessible names and headings

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The current change supplies localized accessible names, corrects attached-property resource keys, and connects existing labels/headings to Settings controls. All 17 current color-picker callers have localized string headers rather than Header UIElements, so the object-typed Header property alone does not establish the reported type-name failure. The inspected Advanced Paste headers are localized strings as well. A more contextual version label remains an optional wording improvement.

**Validation scope:** The changed XAML/resource XML and concrete color-picker header shapes/resources were checked on the current revision. No product XAML compilation, independent UIA sweep or screen-reader session was run; the author's reported sweep is not treated as independently reproduced evidence.

No additional code change is requested by this focused source assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional accessibility or runtime approval.
